title: Repository Guidelines
text: panache R package backed Rust formatting engine. Public R APIs RStudio addins live R/; generated help pages man/, exports recorded NAMESPACE. extendr bridge implemented src/rust/src/lib.rs, crate metadata src/rust/Cargo.toml C registration code src/. Package tests live tests/testthat/. RStudio addin metadata belongs inst/rstudio/, build helpers belong tools/. commit build outputs panache.Rcheck/, Rust target/ directories, generated src/Makevars files.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Enter Nix/devenv shell development required R Rust tools available. Use Task targets canonical workflows: task install installs clean local build package. task build creates R source tarball. task check builds runs R CMD check ---manual. task test-rust runs Rust bridge’s unit tests. task test runs R tests iteration. task rust-fmt task rust-clippy enforce Rust formatting lints. task vendor refreshes compressed Rust dependencies used offline CRAN builds; commit resulting lockfile archive together.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use two-space indentation R, <- assignment, snake_case identifiers, roxygen2 comments exported functions. Keep generated man/*.Rd, NAMESPACE, R/extendr-wrappers.R synchronized generators rather hand-editing . Follow rustfmt defaults Rust, use snake_case functions, keep package compatible Rust 1.89. Run Rust formatting lint tasks submitting Rust changes.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: R suite uses testthat edition 3. Add focused files named tests/testthat/test-<feature>.R, behavior-oriented test_that() labels. Place Rust unit tests beside implementation #[cfg(test)]. Cover happy paths, input validation, R/Rust boundary behavior. coverage threshold configured; every behavioral change include regression test. Finish running task test-rust task check.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: History follows Conventional Commits, example chore: setup devenv; use short, imperative subjects fix: reject empty input. Pull requests explain user-visible effect, summarize validation performed, link relevant issues. Include screenshots RStudio addin UI changes. CI must pass R CMD check Linux, macOS, Windows.

title: Repository Guidelines
text: Use conventional commits NEWS.md automatically generated via versionary. edit hand.

title: Format a file with Panache — format_file
text: path Path UTF-8 Quarto Markdown document. flavor Markdown flavor, NULL use configuration path detection (falling back "pandoc"). One "pandoc", "quarto", "rmarkdown", "gfm", "commonmark", "multimarkdown", "mdsvex", "myst". line_width positive integer giving target line width, NULL use configuration value (80 default). wrap wrapping strategy. One "reflow", "sentence", "semantic", "preserve". NULL uses configuration value ("reflow" default). range NULL, integer vector containing first last lines format. config character scalar giving TOML configuration path, NULL discover configuration. Discovery uses nearest project file, PANACHE_CONFIG, user configuration. Files can inherit settings extend. Lists logical values accepted. line_ending Output line endings: "auto", "lf", "crlf". "auto" preserves first source line ending's style. math Math formatting: "reflow", "normalize", "verbatim". math_indent Nonnegative indentation width display math. math_delimiter_style Math delimiters: "preserve", "dollars", "backslash". math_signatures Named list TeX command signatures, without leading backslashes command names. signature list argument definitions, example list(custom = list(list(kind = "brace", domain = "text"))). table_indent Table indentation 0 3 spaces. tab_stops Tab handling: "normalize" "preserve". tab_width Positive tab width used normalizing tabs. horizontal_rule_style Horizontal rules: "line-width" "compact". lang Fallback document language sentence wrapping, "en". no_break_abbreviations Character vector additional abbreviations sentence wrapping, named list vectors keyed language, optional default entry. formatters Named list language mappings formatter definitions, corresponding [formatters] TOML. Use list(r = character()) preserve R code. Definitions can refer presets names loaded configuration. definition can use code_style_args append arguments per-block code-style values, replacing {value} value. default arity R interface uses resolved line width, capped 1000 columns. extensions Named list extension flags, optionally grouped flavor, corresponding [extensions] TOML. compat Named list compatibility targets, corresponding [compat] TOML, example list(pandoc = "3.7"). flavors Named list filename-pattern vectors keyed flavor, corresponding [flavors] TOML. Patterns merge path pattern, extend; assigning pattern new flavor replaces old mapping. isolated Whether ignore configuration files, including explicit config path. Named overrides path-based flavor detection still apply. Defaults FALSE.
